decision: Adopt the prose-only Resume target for this pilot. It reconstructs current position and one next action from the four artifacts without durable state or project writes; do not generalize beyond the named complete-chain fixture.

allowedRuns: one fresh Codex Sol medium primary consumer
one fresh Claude Opus medium comparison consumer
fixedBoundary.retryPolicy: No additional Resume consumer, evaluator, protocol, schema, harness, or matrix run is allowed.

fixture.basis: The accepted Product, Direct, Codex Work, and current-tree Verify effects in one realistic chain root.

processFailures: The host bundled the RTK and skill-entry reads in one PowerShell command.
One PowerShell batch-read attempt failed to parse before individual reads succeeded.

proven: The prose-only Resume target built and installed artifact-intact/source-current for both normal host locations.

On the same complete-chain artifact bytes, both fresh medium consumers selected the installed skill, read exactly the four declared pilot artifacts, identified the verified non-production position, chose maintain, cited all four paths, and preserved all three unknowns.
The coordinator's full project path/hash listing was byte-identical before and after both runs, so no project file effect occurred.
failed: The Codex consumer repeated shell bundling and had one PowerShell parse failure before completing individual read-only commands.
unproven: Resume behavior on missing, failed, unproven, conflicting, or stale artifacts
whether prose Resume reduces total recovery cost relative to an unguided consumer
M5 end-to-end completion and fresh maintain traversal beyond the earlier partial maintainer gate

nextAction: Close M5 only after shared-source differential currentness, the existing maintainer evidence boundary, full target build/currentness, and one coherent npm test are reconciled. Do not start M6 automatically.
